_설명: 기본 14과 접속사[1] — 보기 순서만 섞여 있던 객관식을 손으로 새로 썼다. 묻는 것과 푸는 방법은 그대로 두고 문장과 보기를 바꿨다.

문항.포인트: B as well as A의 수일치
문항.prompt: 다음 우리말을 영어로 올바르게 적은 것을 고르시오.
body: 나뿐만 아니라 Emily도 새를 보고 있다.
choices: Not only I but also Emily are watching a bird.
Not only Emily but also I is watching a bird.
Emily as well as I is watching a bird.
Not only Emily but also I are watching a bird.
Emily as well as I am watching a bird.
문항.explanation: 「B as well as A」는 B에 동사를 맞추므로 Emily에 맞춰 is를 쓴다.

문항.포인트: not only A but also B
문항.prompt: 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
body: 그녀는 똑똑할뿐만 아니라 부지런하다.
choices: She is smart but diligent.
She is not smart but diligent.
She is smart not only diligent.
She is not only smart but also diligent.
She is not only smart as well as diligent.
문항.explanation: ‘A뿐만 아니라 B도’는 「not only A but also B」로 쓴다.

body: Owen은 너무 졸려서 집중할 수 없었다.
choices: Owen was sleepy enough to focus.
Owen was sleepy until he didn’t focus.
Owen was sleepy because he didn’t focus.
Owen was so sleepy that he couldn’t focus.
Owen was very sleepy, but he couldn’t focus.
문항.explanation: ‘너무 ~해서 …할 수 없었다’는 「so ~ that + 주어 + couldn’t」로 쓴다.

choices: Either she or you is the leader.
Both you and she is the leader.
She as well as you is the leader.
Neither you nor she is the leader.
Not only she but also you is the leader.
문항.explanation: either A or B, neither A nor B, not only A but also B는 뒤의 B에, B as well as A는 B에 동사를 맞춘다. both A and B는 복수로 받는다.

body: If you don't water the plants, they will die.
choices: Water the plants, or they'll die.
Water the plants, and they'll die.
Don't water the plants, or they won't die.
Water the plants, and they will die.
Don't water the plants, and they won't die.

문항.prompt: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르시오.
body: The color of this wall is _______ white nor gray.
choices: neither
either
both
not only
not

문항.prompt: 다음 문장의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
choices: and you will be thirsty
and you will find the store
and you will get sick
and you will feel fresher
and you will be bored
문항.explanation: 「명령문 + and」는 ‘~해라, 그러면 …’이므로 앞말과 뜻이 이어져야 한다.

문항.prompt: 다음 문장의 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
body: Reading is good for your mind
_________ your words
Water the seed every day _________ small sprouts
grow into a tree.
choices: once - until
once - as well as
as well as - until
as long as - once
as well as - as long as
문항.explanation: 앞은 ‘~뿐만 아니라’이므로 as well as, 뒤는 ‘~할 때까지’이므로 until이다.

문항.prompt: 다음 문장과 의미가 같은 것을 고르시오.
body: Turn off the light, and you will save energy.
choices: If you turn off the light, you will save energy.
Turn off the light, or you will save energy.
If you turn off the light, you will not save energy.
If you don't turn off the light, you will save energy.
When you save energy, you will turn off the light.
문항.explanation: 「명령문 + and」는 「If + 주어 + 동사」로 바꿔 쓸 수 있다.

choices: He says _____ he is an artist.
I heard _____ you moved last month.
The baby smiled _____ his mother came in.
She believes ____ Owen is honest.
I know _____ we should be quiet here.
문항.explanation: ③만 때를 나타내는 when이 들어가고 나머지는 목적어절을 이끄는 that이 들어간다.

문항.포인트: 부정문의 either와 either A or B
문항.prompt: 다음 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을고르시오.
body: If you don’t join us, I won’t join, _______.
You must be _______ brave or foolish.
choices: too
both
also
either
neither
문항.explanation: 부정문에서 ‘~도 또한’은 either이고, 뒤에 or가 있으므로 either A or B가 된다.

문항.prompt: 다음 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을고르시오.
body: The girl said ______ she found a wallet.
The good news is ______ nobody got hurt.
choices: and
but
if
when
that
문항.explanation: 목적어절과 보어절을 이끄는 접속사 that이 알맞다.

문항.prompt: 다음 중 의미상 가장 옳은 것은?
choices: Run slowly, or you will win.
Ride carefully, or you will be safe.
Don't drink soda, or you will be healthy.
Speak clearly, or the listener will not understand you.
Skip the ending, and you will know the whole story.
문항.explanation: 「명령문 + or」는 ‘그렇지 않으면’이라는 뜻이므로 앞말과 반대되는 결과가 와야 한다.

문항.prompt: 다음 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
body: I heard ________ Hana is a nurse.
His dream is ________ he will become a pilot.
choices: and
but
when
that
because
문항.explanation: 목적어절과 보어절을 이끄는 접속사 that이 알맞다.

문항.prompt: 다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 만들 때, 빈칸에 들어갈 단어가 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
body: I was very hungry.
I couldn't think clearly.
→ I was ______ hungry ______ I couldn't
think clearly.
choices: so – so
so - that
much – that
too - to
very - but
문항.explanation: 「so + 형용사 + that + 주어 + 동사」로 원인과 결과를 잇는다.

문항.prompt: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 순서대로 바르게 연결된 것은?
body: ∙Exercise every morning, _______ you will feel
strong.
∙Leave now, ________ you'll miss the bus.
choices: and – or
or - and
but – or
and - but
but - and
문항.explanation: 앞은 ‘그러면’이므로 and, 뒤는 ‘그렇지 않으면’이므로 or를 쓴다.
